measurement: /usr/bin/time -lp, sequential builds with the same installed stdlib, codegen, runtime and linker; OS caches not cleared

limitations: One final matched candidate observation; earlier checkpoint variants corroborated the frontend effect. These observations do not establish latency percentiles or a general memory reduction. AOT partitioning is excluded from both binaries.
